usage: The word 彗星 (seoi6 sing1) is used as a noun to refer to a comet, which is an object in space.
彗星 usually appears with a bright head and a tail when it nears the sun.
You can use 彗星 in a sentence to describe astronomical events.
When talking about 彗星, you typically mention its appearance, such as brightness or trajectory.
彗星 is not used to describe anything on Earth; it specifically refers to the celestial body.
